## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `.env.test` content not inspected — the project's secret-file guard blocks shell reads of it. Pre-flight verified that it exists and is committed; the equivalent `DATABASE_URL` (the ephemeral database on the same PostgreSQL server) was injected wherever the contract says the `.env.test` variables are exported.
- Evaluator-driver defects on first attempt — `BLD-TEST-01` (test-output parser read stderr before stdout) and `BLD-TEST-02` (function splitter attributed a helper taking `PgConnectOptions` to a no-database test). Both were fixed in the evaluator's own scratch tooling and re-run once; no project file was involved. The re-run results are the ones reported.
- `BLD-OFFLINE-01` ran with `DATABASE_URL` unset and `SQLX_OFFLINE=true`; the PostgreSQL server itself stayed reachable (stopping the shared container was out of scope), so 'no server reachable' is satisfied by offline mode never contacting it.
- Items flagged `*` (LLM-interpreted bullets): `DB-SCHEMA-02` (catalog renders `'todo'::text`; compared after stripping the cast), `BLD-OFFLINE-02`, `BLD-TEST-02`.
- `DB-CONSTRAINTS-03` passes against SQLSTATE `22001` (not a CHECK violation), as the contract states; this follows the PRD's `VARCHAR(200)` column and remains an open PRD wording conflict.
- Pre-flight Configuration entries for `ENABLE_TEST_ROUTES` and the `SQLX_OFFLINE` scoping are confirmed by the items that use them, not by a separate pre-flight probe.
